hero.kicker: Forged layer by layer in Spain
hero.titulo: Full-size replicas for your wall, your shelf, your next convention
hero.texto: In our forge world, every replica is forged to your specifications and in the colors you choose. It arrives ready to assemble, bolt together and wield: no sanding, no painting.
como.intro: Replicas designed to be built like a real object, not to keep you at the workbench for weeks.
como.tornillos: Most parts join with real metric screws instead of glue. They hold firm, and you can take them apart whenever you like.
como.moviles: Removable magazines and parts that actually move. Made to be handled, not just looked at behind glass.
como.acabado: It arrives with its final finish: the color comes from the filament you choose. No filler, no sandpaper, no airbrush. Unbox, build, display.
como.envejecer_t: Make it yours, if you want
como.envejecer: Into the battle-worn look? The parts take paint and weathering with no trouble: add wear, rust or trench mud to taste.
como.pasos_titulo: From the forge to your army

desc.founders-bolt: The loyal companion of sergeants and officers: compact, yet with an imposing presence. A heavy assault rifle built to unleash explosive rounds, recreated at full size with a removable magazine.
desc.heavy-bolt: The evolution of war itself. Longer and sleeker, with tactical rails along its length and muzzle vents forged to tame the recoil of every devastating shot. The magazine comes out, just like the real thing.
desc.heavy-bolt-wolf: The Heavy Bolt in its wolf version, with its own pack details. Longer and sleeker, with tactical rails and muzzle vents forged to tame the recoil. The magazine comes out, just like the real thing.
desc.founders-bolt-pistol: The trusted sidearm of elite warriors: the unmistakable silhouette of the bolt rifle in a compact form. Robust and angular, built to endure the battlefield and bring all its power into close quarters.
desc.heavybolt-pistol: The new generation of the sidearm: the essence of the classic bolt pistol, scaled up for bigger, more powerful warriors. A heavier profile and a silhouette made for close-quarters assault.
desc.trench-las-rifle: A somber piece for those who revere the grim aesthetic of the Great War. Solid, reliable and precise, with a ringed jacket around the barrel to dissipate heat. Bayonet included. Functional. Elegant. Lethal.
desc.trooper-las-rifle: The hammer of the line trooper: a robust rifle that embodies an unbreakable will. This is no static relic: the power pack can be removed and reinserted, just like the real thing. Bayonet included.
desc.las-pistol: The dependable sidearm of the line trooper. Compact and lightweight, its power pack shares the design language of the full-size las rifles. Reliability can mean the difference between holding the line and falling.
desc.renegade-bolt: Corrupted details betray its allegiance to dark powers. Bolt weapons were never meant for subtlety, only for brutal destruction. More than a replica: a fragment of history steeped in heresy.
desc.founders-bolt-wolf: The Founders Bolt in its wolf version, with the pack's own details: runes along the body and a wolf emblem. Compact, yet with an imposing presence, recreated at full size with a removable magazine. Special edition in fixed colours.
desc.pulse-carabine: Compact and highly manoeuvrable, built for forces that rely on speed without giving up firepower. Its targeting optics and clean, advanced lines belong to an arsenal where precision and efficiency matter as much as raw strength.
